lines: It is darkness that shines.
Even the days we grew used to walking are winnowed away.
Dreams are a stable life, but.
We slump from lack of stimulation.
The light is fading.
Where is the path we were used to walking?
Time can be irritating at times.
Enveloped solely by warmth.
Flames rise.
Toward the guiding light.
What comes to mind is a gentle melody.
They say there is no eternity, that there is no eternity.
I try to laugh, saying that's fine too.
If it shines, someday even the light will cease.
We will keep walking until the day the fire of our lives goes out.
By the way, why
We suddenly stop thinking.
Dreams are a stable life, but.
Because of insufficient knowledge, we are on edge.
If we eat, Yummy.
We decay, still clinging to the present.
This is a furnace of hell, though.
The scar tingles only.
Ripples rise on the water.
Toward the light.
Taking a hand is a new memory.
The night sky separates.
Toward the guiding light.
What blocks is a rigid theory.
They say there is no eternity, that there is no eternity.
I try to cry, saying it's painful after all.
Balloons will someday wilt or burst.
We continue to protect the spring of life and keep it linked.
Graduating without having learned everything.
A heartbreak without having fully expressed.
A parting without having fully played.
It's troublesome, but
It's not like it's hell.
Even the toys that make sound
Even the magic that dispels pain
All of them are treasures to me.
They say there is no eternity, that there is no eternity.
We will keep walking until the day the fire of our lives goes out.
